scope: Dijkstra's BBODY, UTXOW (with UTXO and UTXOS), CERTS (with Dijkstra's CERT, POOL and GOVCERT) and GOV of the Leios testnet build, each applied on its own with every check run: BBODY over the devnet's Dijkstra blocks, UTXOW over the devnet transaction and its variants, CERTS on the default certificate state, GOV after a CERTS setup on the default store of proposals; not LEDGER on its own, ENTITIES or the SUB rules
